# Chess page dependencies

- `chess.js`: chess.js 1.4.0, BSD 2-Clause. Source: https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js/tree/v1.4.0. License: `chess-LICENSE.txt`.
- `stockfish-19-lite-single.js` and `.wasm`: Stockfish.js 19.0.1, GPL-3.0. Unmodified files from the `stockfish` npm package. Source: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js. License: `stockfish-COPYING.txt`.

These files are served locally so the analysis works without third-party requests.
